resources.string: Admin key for spend and balance
Kept in a separate key container next to Kelo, not by Kelo itself, and used only to read spend and balance.
OpenAI: platform.openai.com → Settings → Organization → Admin keys → Create (read-only is enough).
Anthropic: console.anthropic.com → Settings → Admin keys (organization accounts only).
OpenRouter: openrouter.ai → Settings → Management keys → Create.
The provider refused this key. Check that it is an admin key.
This server keeps no admin keys (its key container is off).
Couldn\'t save the key. Try again in a moment.
Remove the admin key? Spend and balance will no longer show.

AI provider keys you enter (and admin keys, if you add one) are kept by a separate key container next to Kelo, not by Kelo itself; Kelo asks it to make each call, and it adds the key only for that provider\'s own address.
